title: Infused Crystal Pickaxe
text: Mining ores has a 20% chance to yield an extra Spiritual Crystal.

In any hotbar slot or the offhand, repairs one durability every half second for 5 mana, even while unselected. Cost reductions do not apply. Full durability or insufficient mana spends nothing; ordinary backpack slots do not activate repair.
Upgrade a Crystal Pickaxe at a crafting table or an Arcane Assembly Bench.
